name: Dr. Claire Nelson
desc: Dr. Claire Nelson, an esteemed engineer, is a leading advocate for space exploration and sustainability. Her innovative work has earned her prestigious awards, including recognition as a fellow of prominent organizations dedicated to advancing aerospace technology.

name: Dr. Hashima Hasan
desc: Dr. Hashima Hasan, a Lucknow University graduate and AMU Physics gold medalist with an Oxford doctorate, is a Program Scientist at NASA Headquarters. Her research spans nuclear reactions, space physics, and international collaboration in space science.

name: Ms. Deborah Sass
desc: Seasoned entertainment executive and World Economic Forum member representing the Global Future Council on Space. Founding Partner of Space Hero, CEO and Founder of SpaceVerse, with expertise in space entertainment and media.

name: Ms. Yara Sofia Fernandes Dias
desc: Yara Sofia Fernandes Dias is the International Director for Space, Quantum, & Economic Innovation at Mission ShakthiSAT with Space Kidz India. She has experience promoting world peace and sustainable development through space education.

name: Ms. Larissa Macko
desc: Larissa Macko, a Jamaican Indian first-generation American, has a background in biomedical sciences, massage therapy, and Traditional Chinese Medicine. After emergency room experience, she founded multiple health and wellness organizations.

name: Ms. Alma Okpalefe
desc: Alma Okpalefe is Executive Director of World Space Week Association, coordinating the biggest space event. With nearly two decades of satellite industry legal expertise, she advocates for accessible and inclusive space exploration.

name: Ms. Huma Siddiqui
desc: Huma Siddiqui is a seasoned senior journalist with over three decades covering Defence, Space, and External Affairs. Starting at Financial Express in 1993 and moving to Financial Express Online, she is a recognized authority on space policy.

name: Ms. Jasmine
desc: Jasmine is a young professional set on developing her knowledge and skills across cybersecurity and quantum computing. After completing her undergraduate degree in Computer Science, she contributes to emerging technologies in space.

name: Dr. Alka Kapur
desc: Dr. Alka Kapur, Principal of Modern Public School, Delhi, is an award-winning educator with 34+ years' experience, 24 as Principal, transforming the school into a nationally recognized institution of excellence.

name: Ms. Meetu Puri
desc: Meetu Puri is a trailblazing entrepreneur and co-founder of TENOTT, a tile wall manufacturing company. She serves as National Joint Secretary of the Confederation of Women Entrepreneurs, advancing business leadership.

name: Ms. Shruti Swaroop
desc: Shruti Swaroop is a global DEI and HR advisor and entrepreneur with two decades in HR consulting and C-suite coaching. She founded EMBRACE Consulting in 2019, supporting 550+ clients globally in organizational transformation.

name: Mrs. Ganga Nidhi Agarwal
desc: Wing Commander Ganga Nidhi Agarwal, deputed to India's Ministry of External Affairs as Officer on Special Duty, is National President of Women-Led Development Council at WICCI, advancing women's leadership.

name: Ms. Nia Leona Civil
desc: Nia Leona Civil is a multifaceted leader in creativity, education, advocacy, and empowerment. She leads GGLOW Education, connecting students with tutors and mentoring teachers using innovative digital platforms.

name: Ms. Nishtha Kapoor
desc: Regional Director-APAC at Eutelsat-OneWeb, she works across Africa, the Middle East, and South East Asia, leading efforts to bridge the digital divide with innovative satellite technology solutions.

name: Ms. Alice Carruth
desc: Alice Carruth is producer of T-Minus Space Daily Podcast, blending media studies background from University of Westminster with passion for space communications. Former television journalist with deep industry expertise.

name: Mrs. Eswari Rao
desc: Eswari Rao is Vice President at an MNC in Bangalore with 26+ years industry experience, leading major projects. She chairs Women Engagement Committee at PMI South Asia and volunteers for community development.

name: Ms. Matsepo Mosoka
desc: Matsepo Mosoka is a Lesotho scientist and Acting Director at the Department of Science, Technology, and Innovation. She leads SADC research and innovation initiatives, hosting international scientific conferences.

name: Ms. Sharon Idahosa
desc: Sharon Idahosa is a communications professional, podcast coach, and founder of Sharon Communications. She hosts HerStory Podcast and Let's Talk Agriculture Podcast with over 100,000 listeners globally.

name: Ms. Samantha Quarterman
desc: Samantha Quarterman is an advocate for youth and families with 20+ years transforming at-risk youth in South Florida. A Miami native, she founded MEYGA in 2001 to empower girls and youth through educational programs.

name: Dr. Susan Villanueva-de Guzman
desc: Susan Villanueva-de Guzman is a seasoned design educator and artist with 30+ years in academia and industry. She specializes in graphic, packaging, and editorial design with international recognition.

name: Dr. Aisha Alteneiji
desc: Aisha Alteneiji is an accomplished education leader with expertise in curriculum design, teacher training, and educational innovation. As the Division Chair of the Sharjah Faculty of Education, she advances educational excellence.

name: Ms. Rosso K. Dieng
desc: Rosso K. Dieng is a seasoned professional with nearly 20 years across digital technology, space, and education, with experience at Microsoft and Oracle. She is Director of Planning and Research at Space Kidz India.

name: Mrs. Gowri R
desc: Gowri R is Co-Founder and Managing Director of Spacynetix Pvt Ltd and a leading tech researcher in cybersecurity, talent, and systems management. With software engineering expertise, she drives innovation in space tech.

name: Ms. Sharon McDougle
desc: Sharon McDougle is a retired spacesuit technician and first Black spacesuit technician and Crew Chief in NASA's Space Shuttle CEE department. A former US Air Force Aerospace Physiologist with groundbreaking career.

name: Ms. Nita Saint-Hilaire
desc: Nita Saint-Hilaire is a civic innovator and data transformation expert with two decades in technology, marketing, analytics. Founder of Qii Labs, Quantum Consortium of Haiti, advancing quantum technology in underserved regions.

name: Ms. Kirti Sudhanshu
desc: Kirti Sudhanshu is a dynamic entrepreneur and humanitarian with 17 years industry expertise and nine years founding companies internationally. She builds world-class teams and drives social impact globally.

name: Dr. Saranya Jaikumar
desc: Dr. Saranya T. Jaikumar is a pioneering Educational Psychologist, among India's first doctorates in the field, Director of Northern Uni India, and expert for education ministries on educational transformation.

name: Dr. Sridevi Arunachalam
desc: Sridevi Arunachalam is a dynamic entrepreneur, visionary leader, and passionate advocate for education, empowerment, and social change. With a diverse portfolio spanning multiple sectors, she drives innovation.

name: Ms. Yip ThyDiep Ta
desc: Yip ThyDiep Ta is an entrepreneur and thought leader at the intersection of technology, purpose, and systems innovation. As Founder and CEO of J3D.AI, she applies AI and Web3 to solve global challenges.

name: Ms. Melina Maghazehi
desc: Melina Maghazehi is an educator passionate about reimagining education for the 21st century. With experience teaching cybersecurity, digital skills, and personal development, she inspires next-generation leaders.

name: Dr. Rattan Virk
desc: Dr. Rattan Virk is an active leader and former Liberal candidate for Greenway with experience in medicine, occupational therapy, and trade. She holds an MBBS from Donetsk with diverse professional background.

name: Ms. Maria Militsopoulou
desc: Maria Militsopoulou is a globally recognised leader known for advancing resilient leadership, mental health and trauma awareness, innovation, and women's empowerment. As founder of multiple organizations, she drives change.

name: Dr. Madhavi Advani
desc: Dr. Madhavi Advani is a globally recognized luxury consultant, TEDx speaker, author, and entrepreneur known for her diverse work across real estate, art, hospitality, fashion, and wellness industries.

name: Dr. Sam Richards
desc: Dr. Sam Richards is the Mission Principal of Mission ShakthiSAT, bringing extensive leadership experience in space missions and international collaboration. His strategic vision guides the project toward advancing space technology and global education.

name: Dr. Kasthuri Venkatachalam
desc: Dr. Kasthuri Venkatachalam is an accomplished Advisor to Mission ShakthiSAT, bringing deep expertise in space science and women's empowerment. With a strong commitment to advancing STEM education, she champions innovation and inclusive leadership.
